newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor dips on low export buys, new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India castor dips on low export buys, new arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed March delivery dropped from 1,134/1,135 rupees to 1,127/1,128 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative selling on Friday, dealers said.
"Export buying was low while higher new crop arrivals prompted fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said.
Daily new crop arrivals of castorseed in Gujarat remained higher at 30,000/35,000 bags (75 kg each).

"Sentiment was subdued but technically the market is oversold and short covering may lift prices from this level," one operator said. Castorseed June delivery dropped five rupees to 1,195/1,200 rupees per quintal but trading was nominal.

Groundnut oil moved down by 2/3 rupees to 336/338 rupees per 10 kg on lower than expected seasonal buying and fresh arrivals of 80/100 tonnes. Imported palm-oil also moved down by 2/3 rupees at 277/278 rupees per 10 kg.
"Actually arrivals of imported palm-oil at Bombay remained low but continued arrivals of imported sunflower oil have depressed market sentiment for palm-oil as well as groundnut," one miller said.
"I am expecting fresh arrivals of about 10,000/15,000 tonnes of imported sunflower oil at Bombay next week," he added.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil remained subdued at 507/508 rupees per kg.
